observation.visible_scene: A coastal scene at a low sun (sunrise or sunset) over calm sea. The bright sun sits just above the horizon left of center, throwing a vertical glittering reflection path across the water. On the right a dark rocky headland rises, topped by a pale multi-storey building; a sandy/pebbly beach curves through the foreground with a thin foam line where small waves meet the shore. The sky is overcast with layered grey clouds. The overall composition stays essentially fixed throughout the excerpt.
visible_changes: Small waves continuously lap and retreat at the right shoreline; the white foam edge changes shape and extent from frame to frame (e.g. more foam around the mid-frames, receding in others), indicating ongoing gentle surf rather than a single event.
The sun's reflection column on the water shimmers and re-forms its broken highlight pattern frame by frame as the surface ripples.

Subtle handheld jitter: the framing shifts by a few pixels vertically/horizontally between frames, but the sun, cliff and building keep the same relative positions, so there is no deliberate pan, tilt or zoom.
The sun, cliff, building and horizon remain at fixed positions relative to the frame, confirming the scene geometry is persistent and static.
No people, vehicles or moving objects enter or leave the view.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the sun is rising or setting, and its longer-term trajectory.
Tide level or wave trend beyond this short window.
Evolution of the cloud cover over a longer time.
Anything happening off-frame to the left or behind the headland.
uncertain_details: Cloud motion is too slight to confirm as real drift versus compression artifacts.
The exact amount of camera movement is uncertain given the near-static background; treated as minor handheld wobble, not an intentional move.
Material of the beach (sand vs pebble) is not certain from the dim foreground.
